title: "Is going to try and throw a Hail Mary": UFO researcher says Trump's midterm loss might lead to "catastrophic disclosure"
excerpt: UFO researcher Jon Stewart claimed that Donald Trump might try to make a 'Hail Mary' disclosure move on aliens. Jon said that the UFO community was disappointed as they saw no sign of the long-awaited disclosure.
content:
Rajarshi Deb

Updated Sat, November 7, 2026 at 7:56 AM UTC

UFO researcher Jon Stewart claimed that Donald Trump might try to make a 'Hail Mary' disclosure move on aliens. Jon said that the UFO community was disappointed as they saw no sign of the long-awaited disclosure. The researcher explained that the situation became even more discouraging after Republicans lost and political pressure on Trump increased. In a discussion with Fox 32 Chicago, Jon said,

"The only thing that there are two things that I take from that, because I am a proverbial optimist, and that is that I think Donald Trump is going to try and throw a Hail Mary, hit that home run."

He added,

"And I think he might use catastrophic disclosure as a way to kind of rally the citizens of Rome around him. You know, have a four-day Colosseum extravaganza as they did back in the Roman days."

According to Jon, Trump could pursue what he described as 'catastrophic disclosure' to regain public support and draw attention back to himself. The researcher also claimed that the president could publicly display a live extraterrestrial, the remains of an alien allegedly held in a government facility, or high-quality footage of a recovered craft which was stored at secret military locations.

Continue reading more about the story.

Jon Stewart said Trump could attempt a last-ditch alien disclosure

Jon Stewart claimed that Trump might turn to alien disclosure in a political 'Hail Mary.' He argued that the president is experiencing growing political pressure after his party lost to Democrats in the midterm election. Additionally, the departure of several congressional supporters of UFO disclosure might force him to make a dramatic last attempt to regain public support.

According to Jon, Trump could use 'catastrophic disclosure' as a political Hail Mary by revealing alleged evidence of extraterrestrial life, including a live alien, a deceased alien kept in government custody, or a fully visible 4K-resolution spacecraft stored at secret government sites. The researcher stated,

"I think he might use catastrophic disclosure as a way to kind of rally the citizens of Rome around him."

He added,

"I mean where we get catastrophic disclosure of a live extraterrestrial, a dead extraterrestrial in retention, in a government facility, or a craft, a clear 4K resolution craft underground in one of these government facilities like S2 Alpha, the Dugway Proving Grounds under Michael Army Airfield, Tonopah Air Base above Area 51."

Jon claimed such a move could be presented as proof that the president was standing with the American public and fulfilling long-awaited demands for UFO transparency.

The researcher also pointed to the disappointment within the UFO community over the lack of major disclosure and said that the public had only seen unclear videos and brief sightings instead of the revelations many had expected.
